Hi Jordan  great questions. I pulled Neha and Rishi in to make sure we give precise language; answers below are what we typically provide for hosted customers, plus options for enterprise addenda if you need tighter controls.

SOC 2
- Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security) as of June 2026. I've attached the SOC2 status summary that lists scope and last audit period; we can provide the full report under NDA.

GDPR & DSRs
- GDPR: We support data subject requests. For hosted customers, primary data deletion is processed within 30 calendar days of a valid DSR. We provide a DPA and standing data processing addendum that includes DSR handling language.

HIPAA
- Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads for Dedicated and Private deployments (we offer a BAA). For hosted shared-tenancy API we evaluate on a case-by-case basis; most enterprise customers requiring HIPAA opt for Dedicated/Private. Happy to loop Legal if Amaya wants hosted evaluated.

Deletion & Backups
- Primary data: deletion requests are actioned (soft delete + metadata purge) within 30 days by default.
- Backups/snapshots: standard backup retention is 180 days. Backups are retained as encrypted snapshots and are not immediately purged when a primary-delete occurs; recovery windows apply. 
- Accelerated purge: we offer a contractual addendum for an accelerated backup purge window (90 days) for enterprise customers  this requires coordination with our ops team and is included with Reserved/Dedicated commitments or as a purchasable compliance add-on.

Logs and Monitoring
- Request/metadata logs: default retention is 90 days.
- Audit/access logs: retained by default for 365 days; can be reduced to 90 days on request for some plans (subject to product limitations).
- Debug traces: retained for 30 days by default and can be disabled for production flows if needed.

Vendor security questionnaire
- I've attached the vendor_security_questionnaire.docx. If you can send back the completed questionnaire we'll route it to Neha (security) and Rishi (solutions) for any follow-up. If you'd prefer, we can pre-fill common fields and return a completed copy for your review.

Concise statement you can share with legal (copy/paste):
"Redwood Inference maintains SOC 2 Type II (Security) as of June 2026. For hosted customers, primary data deletion is processed within 30 calendar days. Backups are retained up to 180 days by default; accelerated backup purge to 90 days can be provided under an enterprise compliance addendum. Request and metadata logs are retained 90 days by default; audit logs 365 days. Redwood offers Dedicated/Private deployments and a BAA for HIPAA workloads."

Next steps:
- Tell me if Amaya requires backup purge within 90 days as a standard term  we can prepare an addendum.
- Please share the security questionnaire back to me when ready; we can pre-fill to speed review.
- If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min call Wednesday/Thursday to finalize language.

Thanks,
Marissa
